name: TrustDemoIND03
title: TD.IND.03 CHW referrals for verification completed at the clinic
description: Of the referrals community health workers make for a child's foreign cards to be verified, the proportion completed at the clinic.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: IMMZC4.uniqueIdentifier Unique identifier; IMMZImmunization.primarySource Primary source. Decision tables: TD.DT.01. Requirements: STT-VER-011. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Referrals for verification made by community health workers in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of referral ServiceRequest (TrustDemoOnesaReferral) WHERE ServiceRequest.authoredOn is in the reporting period

population.description: Referrals made in the reporting period for which the clinic has recorded an outcome for every dose the referral lists.

criteria.expression: COUNT of referral ServiceRequest (TrustDemoOnesaReferral) WHERE ServiceRequest.authoredOn is in the reporting period AND ServiceRequest.status = completed
